title: Charred Veal Casserole
description: A rich and savory casserole featuring charred veal, kissed flavors, and norwegian ingredients.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add charred veal and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add kissed tomatoes and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in Norwegian cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
